title: Immutable attempt 与 diff-first apply

originalAcceptance.criterion: attempt 有 immutable ID、session/worktree/evidence 引用。
diff 和 verification 可在 apply 前查看。
apply 受现有权限审批，失败显式保留。

boundaries: Attempt identity is immutable; no overwrite or silent replacement.
Apply always preflights first and requires an explicit approval ID before mutation.
The adapter reuses existing Git apply and permission approval; no auto merge, commit, PR, Best-of-N or new worktree system was added.
All receipts are agent-driven; no real-human evidence is claimed.
